fields.note: The 2026-27 article now exists (the asset note said 404) and supersedes the 2025-26 fallback, but it still gives only 'May 2027' for the finish, so no day can be filled. The 2025-26 season did end on an exact day (26 April 2026, per Campionato Sammarinese 2025-2026), but that is April and contradicts the published month, so it is not used as a proxy. Format is unchanged: 16 teams, single 30-round table, then title/European play-offs.
